title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under the influence of social norms, policies, information, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe and are influenced by the mask-wearing behavior of their social contacts and co-located peers, updating adoption propensity.

interactions.name: policy_influence
interactions.description: Government mandates and enforcement alter adoption decisions and wearing behavior; locations may enforce local policies.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Media campaigns and misinformation affect risk perception and trust, shifting adoption thresholds.

interactions.name: market_transaction
interactions.description: Persons purchase masks subject to retailer price, inventory, and rationing, which affects access and continued compliance.

interactions.name: norm_observation_at_location
interactions.description: Visible mask prevalence in a location affects perceived norms and immediate compliance of present individuals.

interactions.name: enforcement_and_penalties
interactions.description: Non-compliant individuals may face warnings or fines, changing future compliance probability.

interactions.name: disease_transmission_optional
interactions.description: If included, transmission risk between co-located persons is reduced based on mask use and quality; outcomes feed back into risk perception.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption first reaches 50% of the population.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption level observed and the day it occurs.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_post_mandate
metrics.description: Average adoption rate during a window after mandates are lifted.

metrics.name: compliance_distribution_by_group
metrics.description: Adoption and compliance rates stratified by age, SES, and political identity.

metrics.name: mask_access_inequity
metrics.description: Difference in access/adoption between highest and lowest SES groups.

metrics.name: inventory_outage_days
metrics.description: Total retailer-days with zero mask inventory.

metrics.name: fines_issued
metrics.description: Count and total value of enforcement actions over time.

metrics.name: infections_averted
metrics.description: Estimated cases avoided due to mask use compared to a no-mask counterfactual (if disease module enabled).

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Rt
metrics.description: Estimated Rt over time considering mask-mediated transmission reduction (if disease module enabled).
